title: Rows of stars of the Royal Mosque, Isfahan
subtitle: Royal Mosque, Isfahan

given.O: The centre of an eight-pointed star.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s IRA0501 drawing and its corners snapped to exact values. OA is the star’s point radius. Its two squares and compass transfers of the unit-square diagonal fix the rectangular repeat. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The plain tile boundaries are retained. The palette is illustrative. No building photograph was checked. The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data193/IRA0501: Royal Mosque, Isfahan
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. His page cites Wade IRA 0501 (Royal Mosque, Isfahan, 1611 AD, 1020 AH) and IRA 0718. It also cites Bonner, page 278 figure 157 (Hunat Hatun Complex, Kayseri, 1237–8) and page 144 photo 99 (Friday mosque, Isfahan).

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. They cross at K1, K2, K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through O and K1.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. The lines through A and C cross at K1. Draw a straight line through O and K1.

steps.text: The line from O to K1 crosses the circle at F. Draw a vertical line through F. It crosses the horizontal line through O at M. Turn the vertical line round O by 90°, three times.
Draw a straight line through A and C. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Draw a circle with centre O through K1. It crosses the horizontal line through O at T, right of A. Draw a vertical line through T. Turn it round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a circle with centre O through K1.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre B and opening from O to K1. It crosses the horizontal line through O at P, right of O. Draw a line through P at 90° to the line from O to K1. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Draw a circle with centre C and opening OM. It crosses the vertical line through O at U, below C. Draw a horizontal line through U. Turn it round O by 180°.
Draw a circle with centre A and opening OM. It crosses the horizontal line through O at W, right of A. Draw a vertical line through W. Turn it round O by 180°.

Draw a circle with centre A and opening from O to K1. It crosses the horizontal line through O at X, right of A. Draw a vertical line through X. Turn it round O by 180°. The two new lines cross the horizontal lines through C and D at N1, N2, N3 and N4.
Draw a line through X at 90° to the line from O to K1. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Join N1, N2, N3 and N4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange.

pattern.text: Put copies of the rectangular tile side by side.
